scope: Preserve public Culsma environment requirements for hold and orbital agitation in the OS execution contract

invariants.ENV01: Program temperature, duration, CO2, O2 and humidity must not be discarded or inferred from a profile
invariants.ENV02: Only drivers advertising the requested environment quantities may receive a hold
invariants.ENV03: Program setpoints override profile defaults; simulator acknowledgement is not a physical measurement
invariants.ENV04: Missing instruments and uncommissioned physical routes stay rejected
invariants.ENV05: Orbital agitation retains its exact environment target set and declared duration; unsupported combined conditions fail before dispatch
invariants.AGIT01: A program that omits shake motion can use an orbital shaker only if the selected device capability explicitly declares orbital as its default motion. Explicit motion is never changed.

ownership.ProgramManager: Normalize language environment quantities to immutable execution intent
ownership.DeviceManager: Validate requested conditions against driver capability declarations
ownership.External driver: Translate supported setpoints and retain effective conditions in evidence

diagnostics.driver: Existing driver scope and commissioning diagnostics remain authoritative
diagnostics.AGIT01: Reject explicit unsupported motion in intent normalization and an undeclared default at device binding before dispatch.
